The answer says nothing about statements, their order or their effects.

The student asserts the range filter in the Rainfall loop is unnecessary, which the input (-2) disproves; removing it introduces the silent logic error of adding out-of-range values to sum and count, and neither the sentinel nor the asked outputs (5.0; nothing printed when 99999 is first) are addressed.
